chunks: And among them is Ahmad ibn Ishaq and a group; the Tawqi' (Decree) was issued regarding their praise:
ai.seo_question: Who is Ahmad ibn Ishaq and what is the significance of the Tawqi' regarding his praise?
ai.summary: This passage highlights Ahmad ibn Ishaq al-Qummi, a pivotal figure in the transition from the Minor to the Major Occultation, whose authority was validated by a specific 'Tawqi'' (written decree) from Imam al-Hasan al-Muntadhir. The praise of him and his contemporaries underscores the continuity of divine guidance through trusted deputies during the period of concealment, a concept central to Twelver Shia eschatology and jurisprudence.
